facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: no longer pursued: Wayman changed the deal, and the goblins will wall off the stairs and keep only the church, antechamber and statue room, with Sir Alfred left incapacitated below

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the party no longer seeks to clear the mound for the goblins

facts.text: Wayman promised Snurk never to tell King Hogboon where the Free Goblin Society is living, in the Barrow Mound's church, antechamber and statue room.
